section_summary.extract_value: This is an introduction section that reviews literature on body image, body appreciation, and ethnic identity differences between Black and White women. The current study (Study 1) is introduced as examining body appreciation and its association with ethnic identity in Black college women using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). The section establishes the theoretical and empirical rationale for examining body appreciation as a positive aspect of body image in ethnically diverse populations.
